data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Rosenthal | Henry Capital Advisors' most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FCBM, CBK, and MYFW.

One recent signal: FCBM disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing on September 18, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000110465926108950/tm2625756d1_8k.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
